13.54 policy for the Bengali-speech filter (machine-readable: guard_policy of l_dqual_g3 / l_lid_audit / l_lid_strict; data_map default_saved requested from WP-A): the exact list f4065711... is rebuilt only from the STORED outputs of FLAG_42 (l42_vox2_lid), FLAG_150 (l150_whisper), FLAG_152 (l152_mms), FLAG_41 (f41_t3enc_vox2) and the collected FLAG_53 / FLAG_46 data. In FF_MODE=infer / assemble a mismatch fails; in FF_MODE=train (inputs possibly re-run on GPU, not bit-identical) it warns and the run continues as a recipe-level rebuild with the new list; FF_ALLOW_MISMATCH=1 forces the warning in any mode.

Dataset versions: ngnnguynchn/flag2027-lid-strict-p had two versions on Kaggle (docs/DATASETS.md:76). Version 1 (3/11/2026 10:30): vox2 608 / vb 1 637 speakers, keys mav_v1 / mav_v2 = 46 / 71 (a rule written before, never used), no mav_files. Version 2 (3/11 14:32, the file of this stage, sha256 f4065711...): same vox2 / vb lists, mav_v1 / mav_v2 empty, + mav_files (58). The face-adapter runs t153b / t153c were pushed 3/11 10:59 (kaggle/kapi_runs.jsonl lines 1064-1065), so they mounted version 1; they read only LS['vox2'], LS['vb'] and LS['counts'][vox2 / vb] (t153b/stage.ipy and t153c/stage.ipy lines 539-542; no other use of lid_strict.json, no encoded module), which are equal in both versions (expected.json sha256_sorted vox2 70e36489..., vb 567bb92e... is the invariant). Every later stage of the chain mounted version 2.

guard_policy.read_by: the stage's own cell (FF_STAGE_DIR/stage.json; FF_MODE is set by the runner)
guard_policy.why: the inputs come from GPU runs (VoxLingua107, Whisper-large-v3, MMS-LID, T3 encoders) that are not bit-identical when re-run; with the stored outputs the result is byte-identical. A rebuild (FF_MODE=train) must not dead-stop here, a reproduction from saved inputs must.
guard_policy.exact_list_requires: stored outputs of l42_vox2_lid, l150_whisper, l152_mms, f41_t3enc_vox2 (configs/data_map.json default_saved requested from WP-A) + collected FLAG_53 / FLAG_46 data

env_doc.FF_ALLOW_MISMATCH: 1 = a sha256 / list mismatch only warns, in any FF_MODE (the stage then writes the rebuilt list and the check file records it). Not needed in FF_MODE=train, where guard_policy already warns. Never set it for the 13.54 reproduction in FF_MODE=infer.
env_doc.LIDSTRICT_CREATED: value of the 'created' field (default 2026-11-03 14:31 = the dataset file)
